title: Two Children with Pet Dog on Brick Patio, 1962 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot stamped 'JUL • 62' on the upper white border, featuring two children standing on a paved brick patio alongside a large family dog. The patio is partially shaded by thick overhead vines and surrounding greenery, creating high-contrast dappled sunlight across the brickwork and subjects. The photo features deckled edges and represents typical suburban American domestic life during the early 1960s.
